summary: Veteranpoolen AB (publ) operates as a staffing company. The company offers staff for cleaning, crafts, gardening, and care services for private customers. It also provides staff for shop and trade; finance, admin, payroll, and HR; property management and BRF; sales and customer service; hotel, kitchen, and catering; IT and technology; office services and cleaning; warehouse, logistics, and industry; education and pedagogy; and driving and real estate industries. In addition, the company is involved in franchising business. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden.
